# orion session

Agent sessions started from cards

```sh
orion session <command> [options]
```

## orion session start

Open an agent session on a card's work, with a preset's prompt filled in to send

```sh
orion session start [id] [options]
```

| Argument           | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`             | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--preset <value>` | What the session works on: work or resolve-conflicts (default work)                       |
| `--dry-run`        | Print the link without opening it                                                         |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                                                                                |

## orion session presets

List the presets a card can start an agent session with, and where it would start

```sh
orion session presets [id] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                                                |
